description: Frozen context-boundary canaries for the B-125 CJK lexical profile decision. These diagnostics are not folded into the Phase 0A admission score.

canaries.body: 商店里的乒乓球拍卖完了，顾客买走了最后一副球拍。
canaries.rationale: The note explicitly says the customer bought the last paddle even if a word segmenter reads the earlier local surface as 乒乓球 + 拍卖.

canaries.body: 团队正在研究生命起源，不是在招收学生。
canaries.rationale: The literal characters cross the 研究 + 生命 boundary and do not mean graduate student.

canaries.body: 東京大学生協で教科書を買った。
canaries.rationale: The note explicitly refers to the University of Tokyo co-op even if the context is segmented as 東京 + 大学生 + 協.

canaries.body: 東京都の検索設定を確認した。
canaries.rationale: The literal characters span 東京 + 都 and refer to Tokyo Metropolis, not Kyoto.

canaries.body: 乒乓球拍，是本周采购清单里的重点器材。
canaries.rationale: A punctuation boundary keeps the same relevant query aligned with the document word boundary.

canaries.body: 研究生正在准备论文答辩。
canaries.rationale: The same query is used in its ordinary graduate-student sense with aligned word boundaries.

canaries.body: 東京大学で公開講座を受けた。
canaries.rationale: The same proper-name query is followed by a particle and keeps aligned word boundaries.

canaries.body: 京都で寺院を見学した。
canaries.rationale: The same query refers directly to Kyoto and is followed by a particle.
